title: Maharashtra Boundary
citation: Source: data/districts/maharashtra_boundary.geojson. Dissolved from the Maharashtra district boundaries.

title: Maharashtra Pincode Activity
citation: Source: maharashtra_pincodes.geojson joined with pincode activity data.

title: Built-Up Area (2000-2025) - Dense Areas
citation: Built-up surface change (2000–2025), GHS-BUILT-S. Pixels below 5000 m² built surface per 100m cell excluded; blobs under 1 km² removed. Areas of significant urban growth only.

title: Built Surface Change (2000-2025)
citation: Source: built_s_2025_2000_cog.tif. Clipped to the Maharashtra boundary and colorized for raster PMTiles.

title: Built-Up Area (2025) - Dense Areas
citation: Built-up surface (2025), GHS-BUILT-S. Pixels below 5000 m² built surface per 100m cell excluded; blobs under 1 km² removed. Dense urban footprints only.

title: Built Surface (2025)
citation: Source: built_s_2025.tif. Clipped to the Maharashtra boundary and colorized for raster PMTiles.

title: Built-Up Non-Residential Area (2025) - Dense Areas
citation: Non-residential built-up surface change (2000–2025), GHS-BUILT-S NRES. Pixels below 10 m² non-residential surface per 50m cell excluded; blobs under 0.5 km² removed. Commercial and industrial clusters only.

title: Built Non-Residential Surface Change (2000-2025)
citation: Source: built_s_nres_2025_2000_cog.tif. Clipped to the Maharashtra boundary and colorized for raster PMTiles.

title: Population (2025) - Dense Areas
citation: Population density (2025), GHS-POP. Pixels below 200 people per 100m cell excluded; blobs under 1 km² removed. Major urban agglomerations only.

title: Population (2025)
citation: Source: pop_2025_cog.tif. Clipped to the Maharashtra boundary and colorized for raster PMTiles.

title: Nightlights (2025) - Dense Areas
citation: Nighttime light intensity (2025), VIIRS. Pixels below radiance value 10 nW/cm²/sr excluded. No area filter applied; shows all lit settlements at native resolution.

title: Nightlights (2025)
citation: Source: nightlights_west_india_2025_cog.tif. Clipped to the Maharashtra boundary and colorized for raster PMTiles.
